blockers.description: Older add-on releases use open-ended API requirements and may resolve a stable API 1.0.0.
blockers.workaround: Keep API 1.0.0 backward compatible with the legacy IdmModbusClient(host) Pymodbus path, or use a prerelease if strict beta-only resolution is required.

blockers.description: API main currently fails ruff format --check for idm_heatpump/registers.py.
blockers.workaround: Apply the formatter-only change in the API feature PR and rerun the full matrix.

decisions.decision: Keep v0.10.1 and v0.11.0-beta.1 unchanged on the exact API 0.9.1 pin.
decisions.rationale: Released users must retain a reproducible dependency pair.

decisions.decision: Only add-on 0.11.0-beta.2 will explicitly pin idm-heatpump-api[web]==1.0.0.
decisions.rationale: The API and add-on must be promoted as one tested pair.

decisions.decision: The API keeps direct Pymodbus as its backward-compatible default and accepts an optional public raw transport.
decisions.rationale: Standalone and older consumers must keep working while the add-on stops overriding private API internals.

next_action: Resume in the API repository on Codex/api-1.0.0-transport and implement the public transport Protocol plus injected-client tests before changing this add-on.
context_notes: The current tmodbus bridge passed 21 focused adapter tests against API 0.9.1, but it overrides several private API members. API issue #60 describes the intended injection architecture. No API 1.0 or beta.2 runtime implementation was committed before this pause.
